verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists Sprints as a first-party product feature (clickup-docs-15), and its Jira importer migrates issues, sprints, and epics into ClickUp (clickup-intdir-12), so a native sprint construct exists. Beyond those labels, the pack never describes how sprints are planned or managed. A community comment praises quick status configuration for former Jira users (clickup-comm-1), which is only adjacent support. missing for 10: documentation of sprint planning workflow (backlog grooming, sprint creation, capacity/points), sprint tracking (burndown/velocity reports, sprint rollover), and independent or hands-on corroboration of sprint management.
